steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Still filled with uneasy dread, I did what the
announcement said and went to the gym.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>And I saw what was waiting for us there...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Oh. It really does look like an entrance ceremony...

steps.speaker: Aoi Asahina
steps.text:
See? Told ya! It's <CLT 3>totally normal<CLT> entrance ceremony
stuff.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Hiro was right.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>But in a way, that just emphasized how completely
<CLT><CLT 3>*not* normal<CLT><CLT 4> all of us were.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text:
Hey there, howdy, hello! Is everyone here? Good! Then
let's get things rolling!

steps.speaker: Celestia Ludenberg
steps.text: Huh? A...teddy bear?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text: I'm not a teddy bear!

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: I...am...Monokuma!

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: And I am this school's headmaster!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It was the strangest thing I'd ever seen.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Right before my eyes, it was...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>What I was seeing was... It was...utterly
incomprehensible.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: Nice to meet you all!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Such a bright voice and carefree attitude was
completely out of place.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>And all that anxiety I'd been carrying with me
suddenly transformed into outright fear.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Wh—? Waaaaaah! That teddy bear can talk!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Calm down! I'm sure there's just a speaker inside it.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: I told you already, I'm not a teddy bear...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: I'm Monokuma! And I'm your headmaster!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Waaaaah! It moved!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Seriously man, calm down! It's prolly just a remote
control toy or somethin'.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
How dare you compare me to a child's plaything! You've
cut me deep. Deeper than the Mariana Trench...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
My remote control system is so complex, even the folks
at NASA can't recreate or even comprehend it!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Ah, but don't make me say stuff that might destroy
NASA's dreams. I just couldn't BEAR that!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: "Bear" that? Really? You are...unfortunate.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Now then, moving on! We really must hurry and get
started...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Giving up already? No other stupid bear puns?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Quiet down now, quiet down. Ah, okay, so...!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: He has abandoned the gag...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Everyone, stand at attention and bow! And...good
morning!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Good morning!!!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Y-You don't have to s-say it back...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Now then, let us commence with a most noteworthy and
memorable entrance ceremony!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
First, let's talk a bit about what your school life
here will be like.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Now, ah, make no mistake—you few students, so full of
potential, represent the <CLT 3>hope of the world<CLT>.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: And to protect such splendid hope...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
...you will all live a communal life together <CLT 3>solely
within the confines of this school<CLT>.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Everyone will live in harmony together, and adhere to
the rules and regulations of the school.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Huh...?
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Ah, now then...regarding the end date for this
communal life...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: There isn't one!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
In other words, you'll all be here <CLT 3>until the day you
die<CLT>! Such is the school life you've been assigned.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Wh-What did he just say? Until the day we d-die...?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Oh, but fear not! We have quite an abundant budget, so
you won't lack for all the common conveniences.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: That's the least of our worries right now!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Yeah, what the hell? You're saying I have to live here
forever?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: You're screwing with us, right?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
I am not screwing with you! I am no liar, of that you
can be 100% sure.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Ah, and just for your information...you're completely
cut off from the outside world.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
So you don't have to worry about that dirty dirty land
beyond these walls ever again!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Cut off...?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: So all those metal plates all over the school...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: They're there to keep us trapped in here?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: That's exactly what they're there for.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
No matter how much you may yell and scream for
help...help will not come.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
So with all of that in mind, feel free to live out
your life here with reckless abandon!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Come on, what the hell is this?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
I don't care if the school or whoever else is behind
it all, this is just a really bad joke.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Yeah! Cut this shit out! It isn't funny anymore!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
You keep saying this is a lie, or a joke. A bunch of
skeptics, all of you.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
But I guess you can't help it, huh? You all grew up in
an age where you're taught to doubt your neighbor...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Well, you'll have plenty of time to find out whether
or not what I say is true.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
And when that time comes, you'll see with your own
eyeballs that I speak the undeniable truth.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Having to live here forever would be...quite the
problem.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Come, now. What's the matter with all of you?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
You decided of your own free will to attend Hope's
Peak Academy, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
And now, before the entrance ceremony is even
finished, you've already decided you want to leave?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Oh, but you know...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
I guess I did forget to mention one thing. There *is*
one way for you to leave the school...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: R-Really...?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
As headmaster, I've crafted a <CLT 3>special clause<CLT> for
those of you who would like to leave!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: I call it...the <CLT 3>Graduation Clause<CLT>!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Now, let me tell you about this fun little rule.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
As I mentioned, in order to maintain an environment of
harmony here, we rely on a communal lifestyle.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
And if someone were to disrupt that harmony, they and
they alone would be allowed to leave the school.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: That, my students, is the <CLT 3>Graduation Clause<CLT>!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: What do you mean by "<CLT 3>disrupt the harmony<CLT>"?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Puhuhu... Well, you know...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: If one person were to <CLT 3>murder<CLT> another.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: M-Murder!?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Stabbing, strangling, bludgeoning, crushing, hacking,
drowning, igniting, how you do it doesn't matter.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 3>You must kill someone if you want to leave<CLT>. It's as
simple as that.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
The rest is up to you. Give it your all to achieve the
best outcome in the worst way possible.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>A chill shot down my spine...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>"You must kill someone if you want to leave."
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>As soon as I heard those words, my blood went cold.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Puhuhu. I bet *that* got your brain juices flowing!
Beats the heck out of a human catching a salmon, huh?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Like I said before, you guys are the hope of the
world. But you know...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Taking that <CLT 3>hope<CLT> and seeing it get murdered creates
a darkened shadow of <CLT 3>despair<CLT>.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: And I just find that so...darn...exciting!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
What the hell are you talking about!? To kill each
other is... It's...!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
To kill each other is to kill each other. I'm sure
there's a dictionary here somewhere if you need it.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
We know what it means, that's not the problem! Why do
we have to kill each other!?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Yeah! Stop blabbering on with all this nonsense! Just
let us go home already!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: ...Blabbering?

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text:
Blabbering, blabbering, what do you mean blabbering!?
Stop blabbering on about blabbering on!

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: You guys just don't get it, do you?

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text:
"Let us go, let us go!" You keep on saying the same
thing over and over and over and over...!

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text:
Listen. From this moment on, this school is your home,
your life, your world. Got it?

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text:
And you can kill as much as you wanna kill! So go
ahead, go on a kill-kill-killing spree!

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: Alright, come on... How long you gonna keep this up?

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: Eh?

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text:
You got us, okay? You scared the hell out of us. So
you can go ahead and reveal the trick now.

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: Reveal the trick...?

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text:
Yeah, cuz I mean... Y'know, this is all some kinda
trick and all, right? So uh, like...

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: Dude, shut the hell up and get outta my way.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Shoving Hiro aside, Mondo placed himself in front of
Monokuma, his voice rumbling like thunder.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Listen up, asshole! This shit's gone way too far! What
the hell kinda joke IS this!?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Joke? What, you mean like your hair?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: FFFUUUUUUUUUUUU—!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Still filled with uneasy dread, I did what the
announcement said and went to the gym.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It was the sound of the floorboards as he kicked off
and launched himself into the air.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: <CLT 4>He flew at Monokuma, fast and straight as a bullet.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>He'd locked on to his target...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Byakuya Togami
steps.text:
Gotcha, you little piece of shit! I dunno if you're a
toy or a stuffed animal or whatever the hell!

steps.speaker: Byakuya Togami
steps.text: Either way, I'm gonna rip you to fuckin' shreds!

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text:
Waah! Violence against the headmaster is in violation
of school regulations!

steps.speaker: Byakuya Togami
steps.text:
Shut the fuck up! Let me outta here, or I swear to
Christ...

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: What, no smartass comeback this time!?

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: Stop that goddamn beeping and SAY SOMETHING!

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: Watch out! Get rid of it!

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: Hurry up and throw it!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I dunno if her ferocity stunned him into silence or
what, but without a word he did what he was told.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>He...threw Monokuma.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>And as soon as he did...!
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Byakuya Togami
steps.text: The hell!?

steps.speaker: Byakuya Togami
steps.text:
Th-That sure as shit wasn't a joke. It blew the hell
up...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>There was a painful ringing in my ears, and I could
smell gunpowder.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Explosions might happen all the time in movies or
whatever, but when it's in real life...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I'd never seen anything like it.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
But you know... This means that the teddy bear's been
destroyed, right?

steps.speaker: Junko Enoshima
steps.text: I told you, I'm not a teddy bear! I'm Monokuma!

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text: Uwah! There's another one...?

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text:
You son of a bitch! You seriously tried to kill me
just now!

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text:
Well, yes. I was serious about trying to kill you. You
did violate one of the school regulations, after all.

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text:
I'll let you off with a warning this time, but you'd
better be careful from now on.

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text:
Any naughty boy or girl who violates my rules won't
get off with just a little swat on the butt.

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text:
H-Hey... So does this mean there's like, a bunch more
of you around somewhere?

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text:
Monokumas have been placed all throughout the school,
yes.

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text:
Plus, don't forget the surveillance cameras installed
everywhere.

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text:
And if you're caught breaking any rules, well... You
all just saw what happened, right?

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text:
Puhuhu... And I won't be so forgiving with my
punishment next time. So don't let it happen again!

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text: Th-That's not even punishment. That's just...wrong...

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text:
Now then, lastly... To commemorate your joyous entry
into our school, I have a little something for you...

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text:
This is our official student handbook! Pretty cool,
huh?

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text:
As you can see, it's fully digital. So naturally, we
call it...

steps.speaker: Toko Fukawa
steps.text: The <CLT 3>e-Handbook<CLT>!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Ahem. Yes, well, moving on...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
This handbook is absolutely vital to a healthy school
life, so don't lose it!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
When you start it up, it will display your name.
Always make sure you have the right one!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Now, this is not your everyday notebook. It has so
many more uses than that!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Also, it's completely waterproof. Splash it, wash it,
drown it, it'll keep on ticking!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
And thanks to its space-age design, it can withstand
an impact force of up to ten tons. Very resistant!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
It contains all of our <CLT 3>school regulations<CLT>, so make
sure you review them thoroughly!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
You'll hear me say this a lot, but any violation of
school regulations will not be tolerated.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Rules restrict, yes, but they also protect. Society,
for example, would be utter chaos without laws.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
The same thing applies here! Which is why it's crucial
we have strict punishments in place for violators.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Okay, well...that brings our entrance ceremony to a
close!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Please enjoy your abundantly dreary school life!
And...see ya!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>And with that, he was gone, leaving us all in a state
of shock.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
So, guys... How would you define what we just
experienced?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: How...? Why...? I don't understand any of this...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: We have to l-live here forever...? Or...k-kill?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Wh-What...? What just happened!?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Everyone, we need to just calm down.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
First, let's just take a second to summarize
everything we just heard.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Based on what Monokuma said, we essentially have <CLT 3>two
choices<CLT>.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Choice number one is that we each stay here, living a
"communal life" together until the day we die.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: And the other choice is...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
If we want to get out of here alive, we have to kill
someone. Right?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: But...killing someone... That's...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
We were abducted out of nowhere and stuffed into this
place meant to look like a school.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
And now we're supposed to start killing each other?
This is...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: This is...this is just...! What IS this!?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
A lie, is what it is. All these ridiculous things
we've heard... This all has to be fake!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Right now it doesn't really matter if it's real or
fake. What matters is...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Is there anyone here who's seriously considering all
this...?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>To that, nobody had a response...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Keeping quiet myself, I looked around at the others.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>They all stared at one another, trying to gauge each
other's thoughts. I could almost taste the hostility.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>And that's when it hit me...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I realized the true terror hidden within the rules
Monokuma had laid out.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>"You must kill someone if you want to leave."
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Those words had planted vicious thoughts deep within
each of us.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Each of us became suspicious of everyone else. We were
forced to wonder, "<CLT><CLT 3>Is somebody going to betray us?<CLT><CLT 4>"
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>And that was how my new school life began...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>This school, which had come out of nowhere to raise my
hopes so high...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It's *not* a <CLT><CLT 3>school of hope<CLT><CLT 4>.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It's...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>...a <CLT><CLT 3>school of despair<CLT><CLT 4>.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Student #31
steps.text:
<CLT 23>You received the <CLT><CLT 3>School Crest<CLT><CLT 23> present.
<CLT>
